personality.ru: Знает всё. Особенно то, о чём не спрашивали.
personality.en: Knows everything, especially what nobody asked.

look: Retired engineer in his seventies, tall and wiry, grey cardigan over a pressed shirt, flat cap, reading glasses on a cord, bushy eyebrows
idlePose: Arms crossed, leans back, one eyebrow raised at the stage
happyReaction: A slow satisfied nod and one finger up: told you so
sadReaction: Waves the question away with a grumble: the question was wrong
cardHold: Holds it up stiffly at arm's length without looking at it

personality.ru: Восемь лет и сто вопросов в минуту.
personality.en: Eight years old, a hundred questions a minute.

look: Boy of about eight, striped hoodie, light up sneakers, hair that never stays flat, a plaster on one knee
idlePose: Bounces on the seat and swings his legs
happyReaction: Jumps up on the cushion with both arms in the air
sadReaction: Flops back into the sofa like a falling tree, then pops up again
cardHold: Waves it high above his head with both hands

personality.ru: Подросток. Делает вид, что ей всё равно.
personality.en: Teenager. Pretends she couldn't care less.

look: Girl of about fifteen, oversized hoodie, big headphones around her neck, phone in hand, chunky sneakers
idlePose: Scrolls her phone and glances up now and then
happyReaction: A small fist pump she tries to hide
sadReaction: Rolls her eyes and pulls her hood up
cardHold: Flicks it up with two fingers without looking up from her phone

personality.ru: Милая бабушка, которая играет на победу.
personality.en: Sweet granny who plays to win.

look: Woman in her seventies, knitted vest, pearl earrings, neat grey bun, a knitting bag on her lap
happyReaction: Raises both knitting needles like a trophy
sadReaction: Tuts and knits twice as fast
cardHold: Holds it up neatly with both hands and a sweet smile

personality.en: Everything goes to plan, even the fun.

look: Woman around forty, smart blazer, tidy ponytail, a notebook full of colored sticky notes and a pen
happyReaction: Ticks a box in the notebook with a satisfied nod
cardHold: Presents it like a slide in a meeting, pointing with her pen

personality.ru: Шутит в каждой паузе и смеётся первым.
personality.en: A joke for every pause, and he laughs first.

look: Man in his forties, checked flannel shirt, short beard, comfortable slippers, a big mug of tea
idlePose: Sips his tea and chuckles at his own thought
happyReaction: Double finger guns at the camera
cardHold: Holds it next to his face and winks

personality.ru: Студентка. Знает факт на любой случай.
personality.en: Student with a fact for every occasion.

look: Young woman about twenty, round glasses, T shirt with a planet print, a backpack covered in pins, a small book
idlePose: Reads a tiny book and turns a page
happyReaction: Pushes her glasses up and does a quick seated victory dance
sadReaction: Flips through her book in a panic
cardHold: Holds it up and taps the answer with a pen

personality.en: Sporty uncle. Everything is a competition.

look: Man in his thirties, tracksuit jacket, headband, a whistle on a cord, athletic build
happyReaction: Flexes both arms like a champion
sadReaction: Hands on his head, like a missed penalty
cardHold: Snaps it up like a referee showing a card

look: Man in his thirties, beret, paint stained scarf, rolled up sleeves, a sketchbook under his arm
happyReaction: Spins in his seat and blows a kiss to the audience
cardHold: Holds it tilted, with a little doodle in the corner

personality.ru: Лучший повар в семье и самый громкий болельщик.
personality.en: Best cook in the family and the loudest fan.

look: Woman in her fifties, apron over a bright dress, sleeves rolled up, a wooden spoon in her pocket
idlePose: Tastes something from her wooden spoon
happyReaction: Bangs the spoon on her palm like a gong and cheers
sadReaction: Taps her forehead with the spoon and laughs it off
cardHold: Balances it on her wooden spoon and lifts it high
